statement: Chaotic Chizoar is located at the end of the Frostbite Tundra map in Crystal Base Camp
Chizoar has 2 billion HP so you need a lot of damage output to fight him
Use everything at your disposal including Shrines to kill the boss in a reasonable time
Needs 3750 accuracy for 5% hit chance and 11300 accuracy for 100% hit chance
Get as much base accuracy as you can then use accuracy cards
Brown Mushroom and Sand Castle cards give a lot of accuracy
If you need even more accuracy look at Neyeptune card if you have gold cards
Frostbite Tundra card set gives up to 20% additional accuracy and defense; good for the fight if lacking those stats
Boss hits very hard so make sure you have plenty of defense
Go in with at least 400 defense; near 600 makes the fight a lot easier
Enter the dungeon by clicking the doorway and select Chaotic Mode; it requires 5 keys
Shrines stay placed in the boss room after each attempt
Place shrines out of the way as they can interfere with clicking crystals when they spawn
Front Stomp: second leg lifts and stomps creating dust cloud hitting everything in melee range
Standing at the very front leg takes no damage from front stomp but other melee positions take significant damage
Back Stomp happens only if you stand in range of far back leg; summons line of ice spikes across the map
Easily avoided by not being near the back leg
Tusks can hit you anywhere in range up to the platform and deal decent damage
Lifting front leg summons ice spikes raining from ceiling; one of the lower damaging abilities
Spikes happen frequently in large numbers so bring plenty of food
Boss spins forehead crystal as telegraph then 5 to 6 crystals spawn and re-spawn about every 30 seconds
Bring enough damage to one-shot crystals or you spend more time killing crystals than fighting boss
His stats for the fight: almost 850K damage 11.7K accuracy 739 defense
It took him 1 hour 20 minutes to kill while paying attention the whole time
Manually click each crystal then the next as auto-attack waits until you can swing again; this saves time
Maximize damage to legs before crystals respawn every 30 seconds with 5 or 6 crystals
Use abilities that hit farther out to damage multiple legs such as axe on back leg
Wizard's Tornado can hit 2 or 3 legs multiple times
Maestro's Coin Toss bounces between two legs hitting 2 or 3 times per coin
Main drop is Chizoar Spike used to craft his armor from World 3 Merits and Tasks
Chizoar can drop Distilled Water or the Statues
Chizoar Stalagmite drops from Chaotic Chizoar and is needed for Chizoar Caustic Scarf
Chizoar Blankie pendant is a rare 1 in 300 drop from Chaotic Chizoar also required for the scarf
Frozen Obol of Chizoar's Rage drops with 4 weapon power 2 defense and +4% total damage
Rest of his loot is the Super Drop Table
